what: §7.3 Air control, §7.3a 'level the car in the air' (P1-S03a). Two Cruz Missiles leave the ground 3 m up at 12 m/s with 6 m/s of climb, one tipped 25° onto its right side (left side up), one 25° onto its left. While airborne the player steers into the tilt to start it rolling level, then the other way to stop the roll (DRIVE x rolls the body in the air), and each lands level on its wheels. Since owner playtest 1 the car also levels itself in the air (air_level_torque, R122's arcade control), so no input lands level too; what the stick still does in the air is turn the car (the baselines differ in yaw rate).
